PTI Updated On Aug 29, 2026 at 10:57 AM IST Bihar CM inaugurates first phase of Karbigahiya-Mithapur flyover, Mithapur-Sipara elevated road in Patna Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Friday inaugurated the first phase of the Karbigahia-Mithapur flyover here, built at a cost of ₹249 crore, which is expected to ease traffic congestion in the area, officials said. He also inaugurated a 2.1-km elevated road from Mithapur to Sipara in the city under the Mithapur-Mahuli-Punpun project . Advt According to a statement issued by the Chief Minister's Office, "The flyover connects the Mithapur bus stand with Mithapur roundabout via the newly constructed Karbigahia roundabout, and is expected to ease traffic congestion in Karbigahia, Mithapur and Station Road, besides improving connectivity to the railway station". The elevated road will provide relief from congestion on the Mithapur-Sipara route and facilitate smoother travel towards Mahuli and Punpun, the officials said. national_raw_news.title: 2 hours ago | National 41 PM Narendra Modi to embark on his two-day visit to Uzbekistan
national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will embark on his two-day visit to Uzbekistan today. The Prime Minister will visit Tashkent at the invitation of the President of Uzbekistan, Mr Shavkat Mirziyoyev. This will be the Prime Minister’s fourth visit to Uzbekistan. Prime Minister’s Office, in a statement, said that during his two-day visit, Mr Modi will hold delegation-level talks with President Mirziyoyev to further strengthen the strategic partnership between India and Uzbekistan. During the visit, both Leaders will have discussions on the entire gamut of issues of bilateral Importance in Tashkent. India is among the top 10 trade partners of Uzbekistan, with bilateral trade of around one billion, which is the result of the manifold increase in trade in the last few years. Medical, Mining and Defence are a few of the important sectors in which there is a lot of potential for cooperation. India has longstanding and wide-ranging cooperation with Uzbekistan in the field of defence. A Joint Working Group on Defence was established in 2019. India and Uzbekistan regularly participate in joint military exercises “DUSTLIK”, and the seventh edition of this exercise was conducted in Uzbekistan in April 2026. In View of this, the visit of PM Modi becomes very important and is expected to lay the foundation for further cementing strategic and business partnership between both countries.

national_raw_news.title: World’s largest financial inclusion initiative – Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana completes 12 years today 28 Aug 2026 | 8:20 AM 358
national_raw_news.content: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana has completed 12 years today, marking a significant milestone in transforming the country’s financial inclusion landscape. The scheme was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on this day in 2014. Under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, more than 59 crore accounts have been opened so far, with total deposits amounting to 3 lakh 17 thousand crore rupees. As the world’s largest financial inclusion initiative, the scheme continues to redefine access to banking for all Indians. The average deposit per account is 5,356 rupees. Under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, 78 per cent of the accounts have been opened in rural or semi-urban areas, and approximately 56 per cent of accounts are owned by women. Over 41 crore RuPay cards have been issued to Jan Dhan account holders. The scheme has also empowered millions, particularly the marginalised sections, to access banking and financial services to improve their socio-economic conditions. The Jan-Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) trinity, with Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana at its core, has proven to be a diversion-proof mechanism for the direct delivery of financial assistance. Due to initiatives like Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, India’s Financial Inclusion Index has risen from 53.9 in 2018 to 67 in 2026, showcasing deeper access to credit, insurance, savings and digital payments. As the world’s largest financial inclusion initiative, the scheme is redefining access to banking for millions of underprivileged citizens.
